props.gloss_en: with Pit cast among them, every category comes from the common factor of two -- except Goring
on the contrary, Goring is superior: its object is to cause damage
Scripture wrote all the categories for their distinctive halakhot
Goring was written to distinguish the innocuous (half damages) from the forewarned (full damages)
Eating and Trampling were written to exempt them in the public domain
Pit was written to exempt vessels damaged in it
per R. Yehuda, who holds one liable for vessels in a pit: Pit was written to exempt a person [i.e., death of a person in it]
Man was written to obligate him in the four additional payments
Fire was written to exempt concealed items
per R. Yehuda, who holds one liable for concealed items in fire: Fire was written to include scorching his ploughed field and singeing his stones
